options.title: Options
options.dlnidlnq_smooth_window_tooltip:
Window size of the Savitzky-Golay smoothing applied before computing d ln(I)/d ln(q).
Larger values smooth more (less noise, but finer features may disappear).
options.significance_window_tooltip:
Window size (points) of the rolling-median smoothing applied to the significance curve |I(q)/σ(q)| in the subplot.
Larger values smooth more strongly against single noise-spike outliers.
options.significance_thresholds_tooltip: Comma-separated list of σ threshold values shown as dashed reference lines in the significance subplot (e.g. "3,2,1").

gift.title: P(r) — Indirect Fourier Transformation
gift.qunit_tooltip: ScatterForge works in nm⁻¹ and nm. SasView data are in Å⁻¹ — choose “Å⁻¹”, otherwise all lengths (Dmax, Rg, R_HS) are too large by a factor of 10.
gift.sigma_mode_tooltip: Noise-free simulations have no noise to estimate — assume σ as a fixed fraction of |I| instead.
gift.nsplines_suggest_tooltip: Derive N from the number of Shannon channels Dmax·(q_max−q_min)/π
gift.model_tooltip: S(q) model for the generalized IFT. “None” = plain IFT (dilute systems).
gift.from_ift_tooltip: R_HS from the IFT Rg (equivalent sphere √(5/3)·Rg), φ and μ at defaults. Rather overestimated start values converge better (Brunner-Popela & Glatter 1997).
gift.seed_tooltip: Random seed of the BSSA search (reproducible, documented in the sidecar)
gift.workers_tooltip: Parallel processes for the BSSA multi-starts. The result does not depend on the number (bit-identical). 0 = compute in the main process (diagnostics, not bit-identical to pool results).
gift.apparent_hint: S_ave parameters are apparent model parameters; the actual result is p(r) or P(q) (Weyerich et al. 1999).
gift.gift_done: Done: {n} evaluations in {t} s, {cycles} λ cycle(s)
gift.start_outside: The start value of {name} lies outside the bounds.
gift.need_compute: Please run GIFT with the current settings first (“Run GIFT”).
gift.keep_nonpositive_tooltip: After background subtraction, I ≤ 0 at high q is legitimate. The main plot hides such points for log scaling; the IFT should use them.
gift.qrange_sigma_disabled: The σ presets require an error column.
gift.window_tooltip: Window (points) of the rolling median of the significance |I/σ| — as in the Significance plot.
gift.dmax_limit_tooltip: Set Dmax to the limit π/q_min
gift.nsplines_tooltip: Number of cubic B-splines for p(r) (typically 20–30)
gift.k_tooltip: Stabilisation norm of the spline coefficients. Glatter's original form does not penalise a constant component; with missing small-angle data the default variant is more stable.
gift.background_tooltip: Additionally fits a constant background. It is strongly correlated with p(r) at small r (large uncertainty).
gift.load_sidecar_tooltip: Loads all settings from a *_GIFT_prov.json and recomputes (reproducibility).
gift.apply_tooltip: Writes p(r), fit and provenance sidecar and creates a PDDF group.
gift.lambda_title: Point of inflexion: log N_c and MD vs. λ
gift.no_errors: No error column — significance not available
gift.sidecar_hash_mismatch: Warning: the data file has changed since the stored analysis (SHA-256 differs).
gift.sidecar_reproduced:
Settings loaded and recomputed.
Rg (sidecar) = {rg_old} nm
Rg (new) = {rg_new} nm

gift_multistart.ok: All {n} BSSA runs find the same minimum.
gift_multistart.partial: Best minimum found in {hits} of {n} BSSA runs (secondary minima present).
gift_multistart.rare: The best minimum was found in only 1 of {n} BSSA runs — the MD surface has secondary minima; use more starts or fix known quantities (e.g. φ).

gift_rmsa_degenerate.charge_salt: Charge and salt concentration are both free — they cannot be determined independently (Fritz et al. 2000). Keep one of them fixed.

gift_rmsa_rescaled.rescaled: Hansen-Hayter rescaling active: effective diameter σ' = {factor}·σ (plain MSA would give g(σ+) < 0).

gift_bound.ok: All free S(q) parameters within bounds
gift_bound.at_bound: Parameter at the edge of the allowed bounds ({names}) — widen the bounds or the model is unsuitable (Bergmann et al. 2000).

gift_improvement.small: S(q) hardly improves the fit (MD {md_ift} → {md_gift}) — interaction may be negligible.

gift_lambda.not_converged: λ did not stabilize between the GIFT cycles — check the result (set λ manually).

gift_errors.undetermined: Errors from the MD curvature could not be determined for {names} (flat or non-convex MD surface).

gift_apparent.apparent: S_ave parameters are apparent model parameters of limited physical meaning; the result is p(r) or P(q) (Weyerich et al. 1999).

dmax_qmin.exceeded: Dmax = {dmax} nm > π/q_min = {limit} nm (Dmax·q_min/π = {ratio}): the largest distances are not covered by the measured q range.

shannon.ok: {ns} Shannon channels in the fit range
shannon.few: Only {ns} Shannon channels in the fit range — very low information content.
shannon.coarse: N = {n} splines < {ns} Shannon channels: the basis is coarser than the information content of the data (recommended: N ≥ {suggest}).

q_range.ok: {selected} of {total} points in the fit range ({q_min}–{q_max} nm⁻¹)
q_range.excluded: {excluded} of {total} points ({frac}) lie outside the fit range.

sigma_estimated.estimated: No error column: σ was estimated from the data.
sigma_estimated.relative: σ assumed as {pct} % of |I| (e.g. simulated data) — MD and error bands are only relatively meaningful.

lambda.ok: λ determined by the point-of-inflexion method
lambda.manual: λ set manually (point of inflexion not used)
lambda.not_found: No point of inflexion found in log N_c(λ) — according to Glatter a hint of inconsistency between data and assumptions (Dmax, N, background).

fit_quality.high: MD = {md} ≫ 1: the fit does not describe the data within the errors (Dmax too small, background, interaction?).
fit_quality.low: MD = {md} ≪ 1: the errors σ are probably overestimated.

pr_end.high: p(r) is still at {ratio} of its maximum shortly before Dmax — Dmax is probably too small.

pr_tail.ok: No long zero tail before Dmax
pr_tail.long: p(r) is not significantly different from 0 beyond r ≈ {r} nm ({frac} of the range) — Dmax may be too large.

pr_negative.negative: p(r) is significantly negative (down to {depth} of the maximum) — background, inhomogeneity or unaccounted interaction (→ GIFT)?

pr_oscillation.oscillating: p(r) changes sign significantly {n}× — typical for interparticle interaction (→ GIFT with structure factor).

rg_consistency.deviation: Rg(IFT) = {rg_ift} nm deviates by {dev} from Rg(Guinier) = {rg_guinier} nm.
